**Tessera Help Bot** — Your guide to navigating this educational platform and chatting with Tessera staff. This bot is freely accessible.

**Ask me about:**

- How to start a chat with Tessera staff members
- How to use the chat interface
- Troubleshooting common issues
- Tips for preparing your interviews

**How to Chat:** Click the "+" icon in the lower right corner of your screen to open the chat interface. Type your question into the text box and press Enter to send.

*Note: The Help Bot can assist with platform navigation only. For questions about Tessera operations, chat with the relevant staff member.*
